serverInfo.name: zeever-ca
serverInfo.description: Toronto city services AI assistant — answers questions using official Toronto.ca content

transport.description: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint. Supports initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping. Optional Bearer auth via MCP_API_KEY. Rate limited to 20 req/min per IP.

fallbackTransport.description: Direct REST endpoint accepting POST { question: string } and returning { answer, sources, query_class, model_used }. Use this if your client cannot speak JSON-RPC.

tools.name: ask_toronto
tools.description: Ask a question about any City of Toronto service. Returns a cited answer grounded in official Toronto.ca content.

tools.name: search_toronto_services
tools.description: Search for Toronto city services by topic. Returns a list of relevant service categories with cited sources.

topic.description: Service topic to search for (e.g. 'recycling', 'parking permits')
